mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_profile_slot (user_id, slot_id, use_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{slotId}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE use_count = use_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, slot_id, use_count, preferred_tags, preferred_models, updated_at FROM t_user_profile_slot WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY slot_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_user_profile_slot (user_id, slot_id, use_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{slotId}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_profile_slot SET preferred_tags = #{tags}, preferred_models = #{models} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND slot_id = #{slotId}
